For other uses, see [[Crystal]].'' ---- [[File:Krystal.png|thumb|220px|Krystal]] '''Krystal''' (Japanese: '''ツバサ''' ''Tsubasa'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP242|As Clear as Crystal]]''. She approached {{ashfr|the group}} after {{AP|Pikachu}} had become tired from {{TRT}}'s failed attempt at stealing it. Krystal told {{Ash}} and his friends that she could lead them to a place where Pikachu could get better, but she made Ash promise he wouldn't tell anyone where it was. She escorted the group to a mountaintop lake with a legendary crystal that could cure the ailments of all {{type|Electric}} Pokémon. Team Rocket tried to steal the crystal when a {{p|Zapdos}} appeared and attempted to stop them. However, the [[Legendary Pokémon]] was injured and could not be healed because the crystal was stolen. Later, Ash and his friends retrieved the crystal, and with the help of Pikachu and the other Electric Pokémon, Zapdos fully recovered. Ash and the others said goodbye to Krystal and once again promised her that they would not reveal the location of the lake to anybody. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{electric color}}|bordercolor={{electric color light}} |ja=津村まこと ''[[Makoto Tsumura]]'' |en=[[Tara Jayne]] |es_eu=Adelaida López |es_la=Liliana Barba |it=Sonia Mazza |pl=Katarzyna Łukaszyńska }}
